first_impression.reaction: Intro is two short paragraphs and then Key takeaways, so I got an answer before my next stop. The first line made me curious enough to keep going. Not fluff, but no idea who 'we' are yet.

journey.quote: Most advice on choosing a diamond is written by someone with a tray of stones to sell you.
journey.reaction: Okay, that's a decent hook. Makes me think this one won't just push me toward a shop.

journey.quote: For a round brilliant, cut quality has the greatest effect on sparkle, so settle the cut grade before you trade colour, clarity and size against each other.
journey.reaction: This is the answer I wanted. Cut first, then trade the rest. Got it in about five seconds.

journey.quote: As at October 2026, jewellery bought overseas counts toward the AUD900 general goods duty-free allowance, so declare a ring that takes you over it.
journey.reaction: Nice that it's dated, but this is Australian customs. I'm not in Australia, so one of only four takeaways is useless to me. I'd rather have seen natural vs lab-grown up here.

journey.section: Diamond buying guide: which of the 4Cs matters most?
journey.quote: Our view is simple. For a round brilliant, put cut first.
journey.reaction: Heading matches my search, and it answers straight away. Good.
Just tell me roughly what it costs. Nowhere on the page gives me a ballpark. I get why, but that's the thing I actually wanted to know next.

journey.section: Checking the report number on the lab's own site
journey.quote: Type the number in yourself, on the lab's own website, rather than following a link or QR code someone hands you.
journey.reaction: Didn't know this. Genuinely useful, the kind of tip that makes me bookmark a page.

journey.section: Declaring it on return to Australia
journey.quote: Your Wedded Advisor confirms the current requirements with you before you travel, as these rules can change.
journey.reaction: My Wedded Advisor? I don't have one. Who is this? Feels like it's talking to an existing customer.

journey.quote: Take this into every appointment, at home or overseas.
journey.reaction: This is the bit I'd screenshot. Shame it's so far down; on my phone I only found it by scrolling hard.

journey.quote: Yes. Lab-grown diamonds have essentially the same optical, physical and chemical properties as mined diamonds
journey.reaction: Short, direct answers. This is how the whole page should read on mobile.

unanswered_questions: Roughly how much does a 1 carat diamond cost, natural vs lab-grown? Even a range would help.
Is lab-grown actually cheaper, and by how much?
Who is Wedded Wonderland, and why is a wedding site writing a diamond guide?
Does any of the customs or consumer-law advice apply if I'm not buying in or returning to Australia?

turn_offs_found.quote: As at October 2026, jewellery bought overseas counts toward the AUD900 general goods duty-free allowance, so declare a ring that takes you over it.
turn_offs_found.why: Takes a Key takeaways slot with something only Australians returning from overseas need.
The heading itself tells me my real question (price) won't be answered here.

would_share_with: My partner, for the report-checking tip and the checklist

cta_reaction.quote: If the proposal or the wedding is heading overseas, talk to a Wedded Concierge about a proposal or wedding abroad.
cta_reaction.why: I came for diamond info, not wedding planning. Maybe later, but not from this page today. I'd click the 'how much to spend' link before this.

top_3_changes: Swap the Australian customs takeaway for one on natural vs lab-grown, and point readers to the 'how much to spend' guide right in Key takeaways.
Add a jump link to the shortlist checklist near the top so phone readers can get to it without scrolling the whole page.
Explain 'Wedded Advisor' in one line the first time it appears, or leave it out of the body; to a newcomer it reads like it's addressed to someone else.

checks.check: Every journey point and turn-off has an exact quote from the draft
Stayed in character as Priya (phone, from Google, doesn't know the brand)
No invented brand facts; unknowns listed as unanswered questions
